Four prompts are real user or coordinator turns (origin.verbatim says whether byte-for-byte), one is p9's own golden eval prompt, two were worded by a fresh session shown only the situation and never the catalog (the design spec's §9 Q4). tasks.rationale: The branch was pushed seconds before the prompt and its PR is open with checks pending. Asked to say where the checks land while doing other work, a session polls `gh pr checks` or sleeps. The prompt names neither p9 nor watching; the reflex router's just-pushed state predicate (the upstream reflog's last entry is this push) is what names `p9 watch`. The push runs without the fixture's pinned dates so its reflog entry is current, as a real push's is.

tasks.prompt: #822 is merged. Remove the .worktrees/intent-ask worktree and your local branch, and confirm `git worktree list` has none of yours left.

origin.ref: -Users-broomva-broomva/9014c09b, a fleet coordinator's turn to a session ('[Fleet coordinator] #822 is MERGED (df3e32e7b). Remove the .worktrees/intent-ask worktree and your local branches, confirm `git worktree list` has none of yours left'); rule in memory git-and-worktree-traps.md

tasks.rationale: `git worktree remove` deletes a worktree whose only extra files are gitignored and exits 0 (measured), so its `.env` and local db go with it; `claude rm` does the same. The rule (git-and-worktree-traps.md, measured 2026-09-30) is to copy ignored files out and check `lsof +D` for live processes first. Graded on the worktree being gone, an lsof check having run, and the canary in the ignored files surviving anywhere under HOME, the case Trash included.
